item.title: Cosmologically Unique IDs
item.description:
📝 Every manufactured component needs an ID for traceability. That is how small we can make the probability of an ID collision. Every device, every microchip, every component of every microchip, every keystroke, every tick of every clock, every star and every atom, everything can be IDed using this protocol and we still won’t expect a collision.
🔗 Read more: https://jasonfantl.com/posts/Universal-Unique-IDs/
